title: Auth0 API Token Handoff Repair
outcome: An authenticated NoorPath server session forwards its issued Auth0 API access token to protected customer, operator and platform API routes without exposing the token to the browser.
actor: Authenticated NoorPath customers, approved operator members and platform administrators using protected web routes.
modules: Accounts owns Auth0 session and access-token lifecycle.
Web owns server-side API proxying and bearer-token forwarding.
Customer, Operator and Platform APIs retain their existing authorization and resource-isolation policies.
routes: Authenticated web route -> server session -> protected customer API
Approved operator web route -> server session -> protected operator API
Platform administrator web route -> server session -> protected platform API
Missing or expired token -> deny-by-default unauthenticated behavior
acceptance: The server-side proxy reads the access token already established in the Auth0 session before attempting a refresh fallback.
Customer, operator and platform proxy routes forward the bearer token only from the server boundary.
No access token is exposed to browser JavaScript, URL parameters, logs or client-rendered payloads.
Missing or unusable session/token state remains deny-by-default.
Existing operator membership, platform allow-list and customer resource-ownership checks remain unchanged.
Protected customer, operator and platform routes can complete their API access checks after successful Auth0 session establishment.
Product Owner approval is required before merge; deployment remains separately approved.
exclusions: Page redesign or customer-domain behavior changes.
